title: Have a nice MUSIC!!
overview: Cyan Hijirikawa longs to join the band at school, but is too shy. While worrying about it at home, she's transported to another dimension…

title: With our crimson gaze... (etc.)
overview: Cyan learns more about Sound World and meets SHINGANCRIMSONZ. She sees the power of music firsthand when she watches them play.

title: Yes! Idol ♡ Declaration
overview: Plasmagica gets entered into a battle of the bands against Criticrista, the hot new all-girl band in Midi City. Will they be able to win?!

title: Enchanting Dream Fireworks of a Night Journey
overview: Plasmagica goes to see the concert of a popular band called Tsurezurenaru Ayatsuri Mugenan and are taken in by their originality and stage presence.

title: Maze of DESTINY
overview: Cyan has to fight the dark monsters, but what will she do when she has to choose between performing with her band or protecting Sound World?

title: Ba-dump!? It's a Beach Training Camp ♡ Full of Swimsuits ♪
overview: After everyone discovers the truth about Cyan, President Maple proposes a training camp as they prepare new songs for the Grateful Rock Festival.

title: Yokai Street
overview: Something strange is going on at Yokai Street, the hot new spot for street performances. Can Cyan and the others help solve the mystery?

title: Cimson Quartet
overview: Plasmagica hasn't performed enough concerts to play in the Grateful Rock Festival, and Aion's gloominess is causing problems with his bandmates.

title: Falling Star Dreamline
overview: It's time for Plasmagica's battle of the bands rematch with Criticrista. Will they be able to beat them with their new song?!

title: Reverse Rhapsody
overview: As Plasmagica practices for the Grateful Rock Festival, Strawberry Heart warns the girls about Dagger's plans, but Chuchu's ambitions take a dark turn...

title: Grateful Rock Festival
overview: The day of the Grateful Rock Festival has finally come, and as the bands get ready to perform, Cyan worries about the dark monsters...

title: Our Youth Is Non-Stop!
overview: It's time for the final showdown against Dagger! Will Cyan and the others be able to defeat him once and for all?!
